minor.issue: When cart total falls below Stripe INR minimum (~₹50), _create_payment_link silently swallows the Stripe error and the WhatsApp bot's confirm reply omits the payment link — the customer sees only the order/pickup code. Consider surfacing a clearer note like 'payment link unavailable for small orders' or enforcing a minimum-order guard in the bot.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In commerce_ext._create_payment_link, log the swallowed Stripe/Razorpay exception (currently bare `except Exception: return None`) so silent no-payment-link scenarios (e.g., INR minimum) are diagnosable in production.

OPTIONAL: When simulator/bot cannot mint a payment link, append a short note to the WhatsApp reply (e.g., 'Payment link will follow' or 'Add more items — Stripe minimum ₹50') instead of falling silent.
critical_code_review_comments: commerce_ext.py is now ~830 lines mixing cart+WhatsApp+payments+packs+creds+onboarding-doc. Time to split into commerce_ext/{cart,whatsapp,payments,packs,onboarding}.py.

_create_payment_link uses `except Exception: pass` (Razorpay) and `except Exception: return None` (Stripe) — swallowing every failure. At minimum add logging.exception; ideally raise a domain error the caller decides to log/degrade on.

save_whatsapp_creds does not flip onboarding.whatsapp_connected=True — the review request explicitly notes 'either is acceptable' but if the intent is auto-progress, the checklist won't advance until manual apply.
Onboarding doc uses `f-string` with hard-coded fallback 'https://your-commerceos-url' when PUBLIC_APP_URL is unset — env is currently set, so fine, but move fallback to a shared constant.

Meta access token is encrypted at rest ✓ and not leaked in GET /api/admin/tenants/{id} ✓ — verified. However /api/admin/tenants/{id} does still return the raw `access_token_enc` ciphertext; consider stripping it in admin GETs so only the boolean 'connected' state ships to the client.

_send_whatsapp is called unconditionally from the webhook path; if the tenant hasn't connected WhatsApp, it returns {ok:false} but the code discards the result. Add audit/log so operators can see failed outbound attempts.

rca of the issue: Confirm reply missing Stripe payment link when subtotal<₹50 — Stripe rejects amounts below its INR minimum, exception is silently swallowed in _create_payment_link, so bot reply falls back to the no-payment branch. Reproduction: POST /api/admin/whatsapp/simulate 'add FM-TOM-01' (qty 1 => ₹40) then 'pickup' then 'confirm' → reply omits '💳 Pay securely here'. Mitigation: raise minimum via bot guard, or catch+log the Stripe exception and inform the customer.
